title: Enforcing Consistency and Fairness in Multi-level Hierarchical Classification with a Mask-based Output Layer

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying dataset inputs into 'Male', 'Female', and 'Background' demographic subgroups using a gender-related keyword search, and evaluating fairness using the Equalized Odds metric (calculating the maximum deviation in True Positive Rates and False Positive Rates between these demographic groups across different hierarchical levels).
